name: @compass/cli
description: Compass CLI — capture from any terminal.

scripts.compile: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/compass-macos-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/compass-macos-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/compass-linux-x64
